_doc: Community-maintained database of game launcher quirks Carafe knows about.
When a user adds a game via GameFormSheet, the picked exe is matched against
every entry's `match` block; the first hit surfaces a 'we recognise this'
card with the option to auto-apply the entry's `fix` block into the game's
high    — Verified working by maintainers or a referenced community tool.
medium  — Partial reports; works for some users.
pending — Educated guess; needs first-hand verification. The UI shows a
warning so users know they're trying an unconfirmed config.
To add a new entry, copy an existing block, update the match + fix data,
and open a PR. See Report Compatibility button in the app for the issue
FRAGILITY: exe filenames are matched case-insensitively against the picked
URL's lastPathComponent. Folder hints scan all path components (also case-
insensitive). False positives are possible if a folder name like 'launcher'
is too generic — keep hints specific (publisher + product, not bare 'launcher').

fix.notes: STRONG RECOMMENDATION: skip the launcher. WWM ships a Qt5-based launcher (Qt5Widgets.dll, Qt5Core.dll, Qt5Gui.dll, Qt5Network.dll plus CrashHunter_PC3.dll / detect.dll / dxgi.dll must all be present in the launcher's folder); on macOS Wine the launcher fails to bring these in cleanly. The launcher is used only for updates — once the game is downloaded, the actual game runs from Engine/Binaries/Win64r/wwm.exe (or Win64rh/wwm.exe for HK/Macau/Taiwan servers) and Steam community confirms users routinely launch directly even on Windows. If you DO want to fix the launcher itself: re-run the WWM updater to complete the asset download so the Qt5 DLLs are in place. NOTE: DXVK conflicts with GPTK on the same bottle (both ship d3d11/dxgi.dll) — this profile pins graphicsBackend to D3DMetal so it's safe on either GPTK or Wine Staging bottles. If you want DXVK specifically (Wine Staging only), override per-game in the Compat sheet.

Hoyoverse's launcher uses an embedded WebKit that crashes under Wine on macOS. The YAAGL community proves direct game-exe launch works for the single-player path. Anti-cheat (mhyprot2) won't load — multiplayer modes will be blocked. If installing this game, point Carafe at GenshinImpact.exe (or StarRail.exe / honkai equivalent) inside Game/Game_Data/.

Battle.net runs under Wine 8+ on macOS once you've installed the VC++ runtimes and disabled the crash handler (which itself crashes a lot). Many Blizzard games launch through it cleanly; games gated behind kernel-level anti-cheat (Diablo IV's Warden integration, Overwatch 2's tournament mode) won't work.
